messages:
maria: quick heads-up — after flipping q2b int4 kernels for q2b-small we see a systematic quality drop on our multilingual promptset (polyglot_promptset_v3). rough numbers: 37/200 with reviewer_agreement down >0.2 vs fp16.
akshay: ack — can you paste the failing examples or the query you ran?
maria: here's the quick sql i used to pull the worst diffs:
```sql
SELECT id, prompt, lang, model, score_diff
FROM evaluations.v3_results
WHERE model = 'q2b-int4' AND score_diff < -0.2 AND promptset = 'polyglot_promptset_v3'
ORDER BY score_diff ASC
LIMIT 200;
```
akshay: nice, i'll diff those against q2b-fp16 and q4x8 baselines and check tokenization alignment.
sam: i can spin up a relabel batch for 500 examples focused on non-en + longctx. want to include synthetic paraphrases?
jen: label instructions FYI — focus on faithfulness + hallucination + safety shifts. use the condensed rubric in the golden guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/label-guides/golden_v2 (short checklist at top).
labeler-bot: created task LD-4312: "polyglot-v3 q2b-int4 regressions" assigned to label-team. link: https://tasks.redwood/LD-4312
leo: some of the top regressions look like anchor/duplicate leakage from older golden items — we should run a fingerprint dedupe before relabel to avoid wasted work.
maria: good call. please run a fingerprint dedupe with threshold 0.85. example curl I used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://data.redwood/api/search -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"promptset":"polyglot_promptset_v3","fingerprint_threshold":0.85}'
```
akshay: also going to sanity-check kernel outputs for int4 vs int8 (kv cache alignment, token offsets). if it's purely kernel quant error we may fallback to int8 for specific locales.
jen: tentative schedule: label batch done by EOD -> quick golden refresh + smoke eval tomorrow AM if relabel confirms regression.
maria: action items: akshay -> kernel debug & baseline diff; sam -> label batch owner (LD-4312); leo -> dedupe sweep; jen -> golden refresh PR. update LD-4312 with ETAs. :thumbsup:
sam: ETA EOD 18:00 PT to seed label batch and verify examples deduped.
akshay: ETA 10:00 PT tomorrow for first kernel triage results.
labeler-bot: LD-4312 status updated: in_progress
qa-ops: small note — if we pause q2b-int4 canary, route fallback to q2b-int8 on hosted to avoid client impact. need a short rollback playbook entry.
maria: thanks everyone. if relabel confirms real degradation we pause the canary and open a rollback. i'll coordinate the hosted routing change with infra. will post updates here.
sam: noted, updating LD-4312 with dedupe artifacts and label seed link.
leo: running dedupe now, will post counts + duplicates list in LD-4312.
maria: appreciate it. syncing after labels come in.
